description: Find and compare operator-reviewed everyday physical products in clear cards. See current prices, availability, delivery estimates, return terms, and key product facts, then ask ChatGPT to compare results or help you choose. Open a product on WebAZ to view its full listing and continue there if you want. Discovery requires no login, and the plugin cannot create orders or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Find an in-stock metal phone or tablet stand under 20 USDC that ships to Singapore.

Show the shipping and return terms for the Wood Keyboard Wrist Rest.
